protocol.readerValidation: wave-20261008/README.md Reader validation; ABI/units/start identity and snapshot overhead validated by tw-tools
protocol.acceptance: Eight complete hardware windows in one Chrome session; stable PID/type/start identities per window; no context/device loss; all 17 targets settle; exact same common final visible text, history counts and full retained text hashes; equal public writes and bytes; paired backing geometry equal. Report native per-PID and renderer/GPU/renderer+GPU/all-Chrome CPU seconds, instructions, cycles, matching-clock ratio, P-core share and kernel process CPU energy. Descriptive observation only; no headline efficiency conclusion until independent review and observer calibration. Screenshot and text readback remain outside native counter windows.
protocol.outputScope: Every target visible text, retained row count and full retained text SHA-256 after symmetric trailing-whitespace normalization; same-renderer screenshot hash. Cell style attributes in hidden history are outside this oracle.
protocol.metricScope: Estimated process CPU energy excludes physical GPU and display. Endpoint snapshots cannot recover processes born and gone entirely between snapshots. Counter acquisition is sequential and non-atomic. Observer overhead not calibrated.
protocol.failedWindowPolicy: Retain all completed valid windows; no replay to improve ratios. A rejected driver/admission/coverage window gets a separately registered replacement identity.
protocol.replaces: R02 protocol unacquired; shared WebGPU observer and actual-canvas metadata repaired under R06. Full-stream retention policy unchanged.

retention.mode: Full 900-tick stream retained; prospective workload change

native.coverage: Stable endpoint PID/type/start identities. Short-lived processes entirely between endpoints are outside this coverage. Sequential CDP and per-PID counter reads are non-atomic.
